ticket.summary: New customer reports rumbling/popping from ~7-year-old gas water heater; no leak, no gas smell, hot water working - sediment buildup, never flushed. Booked WH-FLUSH Tue 9/1 10:30 AM at 72 Tanager Way.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed no pooling water and no gas/sulfur smell; advised no shutoff needed tonight, but noted that turning the gas control dial to OFF is harmless if they prefer, and to do so if water appears at the base [PB-04]
ticket.customer_message: Ha - Google has a talent for that! You're all set: Tue Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 72 Tanager Way, water heater flush & sediment service, $139 flat rate. The tech will also give the tank and T&P valve a quick once-over while he's there. If anything changes overnight - pooling water at the base or a rotten-egg smell - turn the gas dial to OFF and call us right away. Sleep well!
